newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Oriental Bank cuts base lending rate.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Oriental Bank cuts base lending rate.

text.p: Malaysia's Oriental Bank Bhd said on Wednesday that its base lending rate (BLR) will be reduced by five basis points to 9.2 percent from November 7.
It said in a statement that the revision was being made as the cost of funds had dropped.
In the last two months, many Malaysian banks have been lowering their BLR, or the lowest rate at which a bank lends, due to a decline in interbank interest rates.
Bank Negara, through a formula introduced at the beginning of the year, has linked the BLR to the three-month Kuala Lumpur Interbank Offered Rate (KLIBOR).
